coverage_questions: The paper does not specify the text tokenizer, vocabulary, token segmentation, or exact text-encoder implementation.
The internal order, masks, residuals, and shared-parameter schedule of the Q-Former are not established.
The image encoder's preprocessing and exact tensor layout are not documented.
Cellpose segmentation, mean aggregation, lightweight classifiers, KMeans, UMAP, and reconstruction-decoder internals are documented only at module level.
The paper gives conflicting descriptions of whether masked or unmasked visual embeddings provide reconstruction-decoder memory; this remains unresolved.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has selection and partition primitives, but no operation representing learned cellular boundary segmentation followed by cropping.
The catalog has no explicit reduction or mean-pooling operation; replacing mean aggregation with normalization, projection, or concatenation would change the documented computation.
The paper documents a compound transformer with shared self-attention and visual cross-attention but does not establish its complete internal schedule.
The decoder is described as a module with two decoder layers and cross-attention memory, without a complete recoverable operation schedule.
The paper specifies a classifier architecture but the catalog has no classification operation with logits and labels as declared ports.
The catalog does not represent centroid-based clustering or cluster-assignment generation.
The catalog has no nonlinear manifold-projection operation.
